title: Why Some Friendships Naturally Fade
coreMove: When a friend goes quiet, friendship flexibility has you ask whether proximity, timing, or energy changed before deciding you were dumped, so you keep the bond.

exampleSpecs.audience: Ruben and readers facing friendship flexibility
exampleSpecs.stakes: Shared structure can make adult friendship feel effortless for a season.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Ruben using friendship flexibility in the source case without controlling another person.

exampleSpecs.domain: Source case: Atlanta couple moving across the street
exampleSpecs.audience: Samira and readers facing friendship flexibility
exampleSpecs.stakes: A painful shift can be normal social physics instead of deliberate replacement.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Samira using friendship flexibility in the source case without controlling another person.
